items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-02
items.q: But when I looked around, those two arms was hugging me, Detective A.

ctx.x: Did the kids you played with think you were about the best that they'd heard?

Well, we wasn't thinking about who was the best or anything in those days. We're just glad we could sing together and sound so good. When did you first start to get there? So when I got to the age where I noticed everybody celebrate Christmas and New Year's Eve with pistols, Roman cannons, shotguns, cannons, anything they got in the processions, they shoot it up there, but I didn't know that there was a law against it. See, you can get away with it, all right, see. Well, I kept on finding my stepfather's old…
Louis, who would you say was the greatest influence on your life? Not in your youth, not musicians, I mean individuals. In your family or?
